threads.body:
@copilot Please fix the CI failure introduced by this ASM bump.

The dependency constraints upgrade `asm`, `asm-tree`, and `asm-util` to 9.11, but leave `asm-commons` at the transitive version 9.10.1 pulled in by Aries SPI Fly. Its OSGi manifest imports core ASM in `[9.10.1,9.11.0)`, which excludes 9.11. Both downloaded representative CI jobs fail at `:smoke-tests-osgi:apiNoIncubatorResolve` with this dependency chain, rather than an actual missing OpenTelemetry package.

Add `org.ow2.asm:asm-commons:${asmVersion}` to `CORE_DEPENDENCIES` in this file to align it with the other ASM artifacts. Keep the fix limited to this dependency-resolution failure and validate with `./gradlew :smoke-tests-osgi:test -PtestJavaVersion=17`.

Failure log: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/actions/runs/38325902981/job/115064640579

threads.body: [General] This new constraint upgrades `asm-commons` to 9.11, but both generated entries in `licenses/licenses.md` still report 9.10.1 (lines 236 and 295), unlike the other ASM artifacts updated in this PR. Regenerate the license report so the dependency inventory matches the resolved version.
